fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
fields.rationale: AXI/ACE does not define a JTAG/scan/BIST/MBIST/debug architecture. Debug visibility must be added by the integrator (typically via ARM CoreSight components).

spec_provided_observability.name: RRESP[3:0] full encoding
spec_provided_observability.purpose: PassDirty + IsShared bits expose coherency state.

spec_provided_observability.name: Coherency monitor (architectural)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Implementation-defined point of serialization for trace/debug.

ace_optional_features_via_properties: DVM support — DVMMessage / DVMComplete; optional per implementation.
fields.boundary_with_AXI5_E_features: AXI5 (AMBA 5) E-series features (cache stashing, deallocating transactions, atomic transactions, MPAM, tagging) are NOT part of IHI 0022E — they belong to AXI5/ACE5 successor specs.
